identity_boundary: Jo Kyong Hun, listed by OFAC as JO, Kyong Hun with the Hangul name 조경훈 and alternate romanization CHO, Kyo'ng-hun, is the Korea Sobaeksu IT team leader described in Treasury’s July 2025 sanctions action. The source records an administrative designation and designation-time location posture; criminal-case, present-location, and same-named-account ownership status remain unverified.
